title: Just like Dollar Tree Cups
text: Just like Dollar Tree Cups. Fine, I am a huge Harry Potter fan, despite who wrote it, and I knew I needed this cup in my life because of the amount of hot coffee I drink in the winter. This cup is pretty great. Just a simple cup that looks awesome, but the top doesn't just pop on and off, but instead does screw into the inside so it does stay in place. The bottom does have silicone so that it doesn't slide around on the table but stays in place. The only thing that I wish was better is the top where you drink from because it stays open with just a slit at the top. So, if you were to shake it or something else, it will spill. So if that were better this cup would totally get five stars but honestly, while I love the Harry Potter theme, I can get a cup just like this at Dollar Tree.
